doc.title: James Hunter interviewed by Monk Rowe, Boston, Massachusetts, July 25, 2018

title: Covers of his songs and publishing
summary: Lisa Mills covered 'Kick It Around', and Hunter says he doesn't own his publishing.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: Have you ever had another band cover your tunes?

Yeah it’s nice to hear. What was her name now, this nice lady who covered “Kick It Around.” Lisa Mills. She’s American but she does a lot of her work in England. And she covered “Kick It Around.” She sang it very well but I can’t let her off because she left off these — I said you took out two chords that distinguished it. It was in C something and there was an A flat and I said what did you leave that out for? That’s the best bit. She took it very well.
Do you own your own publishing?

No I don’t. I think we’ve got in-house publishing with the record. Somebody did try to persuade me to start a publishing company and I don’t know if I could have made more loot with that or not. Maybe it’s worth looking into.
